records.Message: VENDING MACHINE CRISIS! HELP, <player>!
[Sticker]
I pressed for original cola, and guess what? Got stuck with CARROT COLA!
Everyone knows carrot cola is nasty. Chaos must be messing with my fav machine. Ugh.
Calm down…
Could just be broken.
Or maybe it’s sabotage.
Someone’s out to poison me with carrot cola.
Ah, looks like the restocking truck is here.
Guess they just ran out. All good now! Case closed!
Enjoy.
Get me one to make up for your 5 min drama.
I’ve still got the carrot one. It’s all yours.
Sup?
Causing trouble again?
I dunno what you think of me, but no.
Chaos spotted. Southwest corner of the city.
Ping me. BRT
My time to shine.
Sorry, handled it. All good now.
Thanks, cottontail crusader.
Ew. Don’t ever call me that IRL, or you’re done.
Thank you, rabbit-eared rescuer.
I’m just gonna stop talking to you. For now.
Full of uncertainty, unruliness, and untruth.
Did cola brainrot finally catch up to you?
That was a line from my most hyped manga, High School BxG!
Well, used to be the hypest. The mag axed it for good.
I just don’t get it. The style’s fire, plot’s INSANE, and the fight scenes are next level!
What’s a BxG?
Bancho x Gods. It’s a manga where high school delinquents fight deities.
Why is everything set in high school?
What do you mean why? Everything happens in high school. Duh.
You’re missing the point here. They axed the whole thing after just 3 chapters.
How am I supposed to know who wins now? I’m betting on the track and field team captain, but Destroyer of Light seems OP too.
How does a track and field captain even fight a god?
Sounds pretty obvious to me who would win.
See? Now you’re hooked, too.
Pity we’ll never find out how the fight ends.
…I’m sure you’ll find a new obsession soon enough.
Best Kalbi in town. Period. They serve a mean Yaki Onigiri too.
Sounds amazing…and now I’m starving.
Ugh, the FOMO is real…
Let’s hit it up together next time you’re around. My treat!
[Sticker]
Awesome, thanks!
Until we meet again, Garm the Gourmet!
I can’t wait to see your reaction!
Are you dealing with some new chaos trouble?
I’m good, but my bank account’s not.
Barely got enough for a cola, but I swear I didn’t spend much. Probably just my phone acting up.
Your phone seems fine for texting, though.
Must be the bank, then?
Best check your transactions.
Can’t all be me, but let’s see.
Well, it’s all on me. Somehow racked up a crazy amount.
[Sticker]
You’re not gonna starve, right?
Nah, I’ll be fine.
HMU if you need anything.
…Yeah, I need a crash course in adulting, if anything.
Garm?
Sup?
Tooth’s acting up…
Looks like someone’s tooth is protesting against sugar at last.
Hey, I’ll have you know, I brush twice a day.
…Did you get into a fight and take a hit to the mouth?
Who, me? Ha!
It just feels a bit wobbly when I bite into stuff.
Really annoying. I might just yank it out.
Wait, what?
That’s not how you deal with teeth.
Really?
It’s out now.
Did it hurt?
Not really. New tooth already grew in.
Hey, caught you ballin’ at the court the other day.
Could use a shooter like you on my team.
You any good?
I’m not trying to carry the whole team.
Ha! I practically grew up on the court.
I could probably pull off a double-double before halftime.
[Sticker]
FR? Let’s see you eat those words.
I’ll eat the whole ball if I flop.
Okay, I’m in.
Alright! Let’s do this!
Hey <player>, need your help ASAP!
I’m trapped in a Chaos space.
My services don’t come cheap, you know.
C’mon, don’t bail on me. Help a friend out?
How did you get trapped?
I can’t reveal the details…
But I tailed [classified] to [classified] location in order to [classified].
And now because of [classified], I’m stuck in a Chaos space.
Can’t help if you’re keeping me in the dark, man.
Maybe you could escape by [classified].
Wait… I think you’re onto something.
The key is to not say anything! I got it thx!
Huh? What did you get?
Now I’m totally lost.
You were right, I’m out! TYSM! You’re the best!
Uh, no problem, I guess…
Yo, just copped two tickets to the hottest gig in town!
[Sticker]
You know what that means, right?
Sweet!
I knew you’d be stoked.
So, how much you need for ’em?
Scalping? C’mon, you know me better than that.
It’s on me. Let’s just enjoy it.
Awesome!!
Snagged us front-row spots. I’ll bring the lightsticks.
[Sticker]
[Sticker]
Got some epic mechanical weaponization upgrade ideas, need your input!
I know a bit about it.
Not sure if I’m the right one for this.
Don’t worry, it’s not too tech-y, I promise. I just want to amp up Coeus’ weapons.
You’re the coolest Agent I know, so I thought you could help me out!
Well… How about adding laser cannons?
Everyone likes lasers.
I feel the same way!
Load Coeus up with the biggest ammo clip you can find.
More ammo, more firepower.
Makes sense!
How about adding some deep bass speakers?
Coeus would totally get pumped with sick beats in the background.
Music as a morale boost?
Cool idea… I’m on it.
Oh, and one more thing…
Mecha would love to check out that weapon of yours up close.
Just for a couple of hours, pretty please?
Sorry, it’s not really up to me.
Agents policy.
Ah, I see…
Fair enough.
But if you ever need quick repairs for that weapon, swing by anytime!
Quick question—
I heard someone say my beat is “dirty”. Do they mean it needs to sound cleaner?
Nah, they mean your music is raw and intense.
Oh, got it! Thanks!
I know you do your own thing. But nothing wrong with paying more attention to the scene.
I see. I’ll work on it.
What about when someone says a song “slaps hard”?
It doesn’t mean it sounds like someone’s getting slapped, right?
It means it’s super catchy and full of energy.
And when they say the drop is “nasty”?
They mean it hits hard and feels super satisfying.
They like the “nasty” stuff.
Ah, I see.
I was starting to worry everyone hates my music.
Thanks a bunch.
So… does that mean you like my music too? <player>.
You did say my beat was “sick” the other day, <player>.
When someone says your beat is sick, it’s a big compliment.
Yup, I love your music.
Phew, I’ve been stressing about that comment for a while, <player>.
Thanks for clearing that up, and for liking my music.
I’ll send over my latest rough cut. Check it out when you can!
You’ve got connections as an agent, right?
So, where could someone get, like, a ton of black powder?
Huh?
Yeah, and fast! I kinda need it ASAP.
You’re not building some sort of super-destructive machine, are you?
What? No way! …Not this time, at least.
I watched this amazing documentary on fireworks the other day.
They went on about how tough it is to build an automatic launcher…
So, I designed one myself!
Now I just need some fireworks to kick off my very own fireworks show!
Maybe you should just grab some pre-made fireworks.
I hear the store-bought ones are already pretty good.
Makes sense!
Yeah, I should probably leave that to the pros.
But hey, once everything’s ready…
You’ll come check out my fireworks show, right, <player>?
Yo, guess what?
What?
Okay, so…
Finished a new piece?
Nah, but this is almost as dope.
I’ve had this tune stuck in my head for days.
Couldn’t figure out what it was for the life of me.
Ended up digging through all my music apps, short vids, and browser history.
That’s a lot of effort for one earworm.
Ikr?
Replayed so many tracks my brain was ready to explode!
It was like an itch I couldn’t scratch.
I was almost about to give up…
But a legit miracle happened!
I was passing this street corner joint
and what do you know? They were playing that song!
Good for you.
Itch successfully scratched, I guess.
Yup!
Hope you’re just as lucky with your next earworm.
Speaking of which, got another tune stuck in my head now…
Sup?
Well…
Ah…
I sighed first. I’ll start!
Got nabbed by a cop today…
Did you get in trouble?
In a way… I guess so…
I know a guy. Might be able to get you out.
Seriously? You’d do that for me?
But it’s not that bad, really.
I was strolling by Portview Lane when I spotted… the perfect wall!
The spot, the texture, the vibe. Everything was on point…
Perfect for my new piece.
I just had to hit it up right then and there.
[Sticker]
Please don’t say there were officers nearby.
[Sticker]
They just dragged me back and gave me an earful.
Made me scrub it all off…but I snagged a pic!
Hey, you been to Fluffington Cafe?
Ofc I have.
Cat person, huh? Me too.
Nope.
You gotta check it out, frfr.
Why? What is it?
Can’t believe you don’t know.
It’s a cat cafe on Glimmergold Lane. You can chill with cats and soak in their vibe there.
I’m a regular, btw.
Even did some sick wall art for them.
They said I’m like a cat, too. Can you believe it?
Because you’re cute like a cat?
Hmmm.
Could be, you know?
Knew someone would pick up on my charm eventually!
Because you cause trouble like a cat?
You take that back!
Neither me nor cats cause trouble!
We just… get carried away sometimes!
Anyway, it definitely wasn’t because of that!
[Sticker]
[Sticker]
This emote feature is really handy! You can save them with just a tap.
You also like to use stickers!?
I don’t even know how to talk without emotes.
Totally get you!
I just sent them out without even thinking!
Ikr? I end up saving so many.
These are the ones I use every day!
[Sticker]
[Sticker]
[Sticker]
[Sticker]
Saved
You’re welcome!
Plenty more where those came from!
[Sticker]
Ugh, I can barely keep my eyes open.
It’s all because of that freaky rumor about messed up stuff going down when you tune into channel 13 at 3:33 am.
So, of course, I had to try it out.
You stayed up until 3 just for that?
Ofc!
How else was I gonna bust that myth?
Sounds like a total hoax to me.
That’s what I figured.
Still, how else would I debunk the rumor?
So, did anything happen?
Nothing, really. Boring old TV commercials all night long.
I even recorded the whole thing and threw it online.
…The homeroom teacher was super mad when I fell asleep this morning.
[Sticker]
I mean, if you count the teacher being mad at you as a bad thing…
But reasonable doubts are essential to critical thinking.
Is that praise I hear?
[Sticker]
It’s hard to debunk some of these things.
Good job.
Ikr!
[Sticker]
[Sticker]
Quick! Which is better—Lava cake or caramel pudding?
Better as a dessert, obviously! I’m heading to Dream Garden Cafe soon.
One does not simply choose between cake and pudding.
[Sticker]
C’mon, help me out! I seriously can’t decide!
Lava cake ftw!
Right! Soft, sweet, and that oozing center…
Cake it is!
Pudding. Always pudding.
Good choice! Silky, rich, and melt-in-your-mouth creamy!
Pudding it is!
Why not both?
I wish! But I’m on a diet right now.
They should totally do mini sizes for us who wanna try everything!
Btw, I’ve got loads of coupons.
HMU if you need any!
[Sticker]
Excuse me, <player>, might I request a favor?
What’s up?
Depends on what you’re asking.
Would you care to join me as a gaming companion?
It’s a game called “Sleuths in Shadows.” Intrigued?
Okay, but how’s it played?
Never heard of it. What’s the deal?
Goodness, are you serious? This game has become quite the sensation.
Players take on various personas, seek out clues, and diligently piece together their truths.
Sounds pretty intense.
That’s precisely what makes it enjoyable, wouldn’t you agree?
Seems straightforward, I guess.
Ha! That’s why I’ve dubbed you my Watson.
I’ll interpret that as a yes, then.
I shall contact you once I’ve assembled sufficient players.
[Sticker]
[Sticker]
[Sticker]
Just checking in. Are you unraveling mysteries, Watson?
Just chilling.
Chilling? Cold case or something? I’m good at cracking those too.
On the grind.
Grinding? You making coffee or solving cases? Either way, count me in!
[Sticker]
My, I find myself rather bored…
The recent cases have been dreadfully ordinary.
[Sticker]
I usually sleep when I’m bored.
Indeed, but I long for a reason to rise from my slumber.
So why not go out and have some fun?
A splendid idea. I shall emerge from beneath my comforters.
Pardon me, do you have any plans later?
Would you care to accompany me for some shopping? I shall express my gratitude with a few items of your choosing.
Sure. See you at the mall in an hour?
Delightful! Await me at the east gate!
Sorry, rain check.
I shall hold you to that!
[Sticker]
Could I use five minutes of your time?
Ofc. Sup?
How can I help?
Before honing my archery, I would meditate to heighten my concentration.
However, of late, my meditation has proven inadequate.
I am inquiring if you possess any secret techniques to sustain focus.
I’ve got a few tricks that might help.
Not exactly secret techniques, but I’m down to share.
Please, guide me.
What do you think about when you are distracted?
Mapo Tofu.
To say I think of it is an understatement. I yearn for it.
The delicate tofu, enveloped in a fiery, mouth-numbing sauce. I can almost sense its fragrance as I type.
How long has it been since you last had Mapo Tofu?
How long have you been dealing with this?
It has been precisely 13 days, 14 hours, and 22 minutes since I last indulged in Mapo Tofu. My focus waned about a week thereafter.
Got it. Just make sure to treat yourself to Mapo Tofu once a week.
Is this your secret technique?
I am grateful. I will integrate this into my practice.
More and more are exchanging traditional arms for modern firearms.
If I am to keep pace with the times, should I consider transitioning to modern firearms?
What are your thoughts, <player>?
For ranged attacks, guns are superior.
For close combat… guns are superior.
I see. So, you also believe that guns surpass swords?
I think I’ll stick to my Ripsaw.
I see. Despite the shifting tides, you remain true to your weapon.
Your words have slashed away my uncertainties.
For that, I am grateful.
Uh, okay… You’re welcome, I guess.
It… truly is my friend asking.
Not I.
Sure… What’s the question?
In your youth, did you ever envision yourself as a covert hero lurking in the ordinary?
That’s who I am now.
I see…
It’s a common daydream among kids, I suppose.
I understand… My comrade will find solace in your words.
Another matter. Some recall my comrade’s fantasies and may jest about them.
How might she erase their memory?
This weighs heavily on her, hence why she’s approached you through me.
Well, time heals best.
So her best course is to wait for their memories to fade.
The easiest way is to cut off all ties with them imo.
I see… Thankfully, my blade can sever even that which lacks form.
I will convey your wisdom to my comrade.
Thank you.
I guess even the ever-composed Dila can forget things sometimes.
Which library? Hope the overdue fee isn’t too much.
Wondering if the door’s really locked after hopping on the subway…
…Unsettling.
Yeah, thoughts be like that sometimes.
Feeling like something important still needs to be done right before bed…
But can’t figure out what it is.
Have you had a particularly stressful day?
[Sticker]
My day’s been fine. Just brainstorming some anxiety-inducing moments for my new story.
Getting the heebie-jeebies yet?
Yeah, sounds like stuff straight out of my life.
Exactly! That’s what makes it extra scary.
…I just double-checked if my door’s locked.
Seems like it’s working, then.
[Sticker]
Oh, I just thought of something even scarier.
I messed up and posted my alt’s stuff on main!
Enough!
[Sticker]
It was just lying in the doorway. They probably slid it in through the door gap.
Having a fan base is a good thing, right?
Congrats! Must be a proud moment for a writer.
Yeah, but… I never gave my address to anyone.
Did you get doxxed? Get any sketchy DMs lately?
I don’t know… The letter even uses my real name, not my pen name.
Might be some kind of prank by a friend?
Could be… the letter used my real name instead of my pen name.
This is what it says…
I reveal myself to you, a creature of Chaos in the form of a letter most ordinary.
Look behind you if you wish to seek solace within darkness.
Omw. Don’t turn around, Dila.
[Sticker]
I’m really sorry, <player>. You don’t have to come over… It’s just a new idea I’m trying out for my story.
I was struggling with some of the dialogue and reactions, so…
Still there? I’m so sorry! Can I make it up to you somehow? Wanna grab dinner? My treat!
[Sticker]
I’d need to hit up a movie in those plush, premium cinema seats to calm down…
I heard they released new seasonal dishes at the Dream Garden Cafe…
[Sticker]
Say no more. Meet me there.
Know anywhere fun and exciting, <player>? Need some inspo for my latest piece.
I hear there’s a heavy metal gig in Paradox Plaza tonight.
Chaos breaking loose in the middle of a killer guitar solo… Could work!
Gotta look the part too. Where can I snag some studded belts and boots right now?
Observe, Dila, don’t disturb.
[Sticker]
The Televised Collective have an event in the Azure Sector tonight.
Looked it up, seems like a drive-in movie thing. Hold up…
Three mob gore flicks in one night? That’s a whole lot of action and blood.
Well, you know how they do. Just watch your back.
Yeah, all those young gang members, riled up and ready to throw down… This will be good.
Rixxy Wonderland is throwing its annual Splash Bash event.
I looked it up. Seems like the Jello Chaos are extra active this time of year.
You buy a water gun at the entrance and…repel the rampaging Rixxies into the sea?
Isn’t that the staff’s job? Whoever runs that place sure knows how to do business.
[Sticker]
Alrighty. Thanks for the tip.
Can’t wait to check it out.
And I can’t wait for your new story.
[Sticker]
Sure, count me in.
Hm… Tell me more.
We like to keep it fresh—switch things up from time to time.
So we’re testing out three potential new dishes to add one to the menu.
[Sticker]
We’ve been at it for days. We need your input to settle the score.
No sweat, I got this.
Let’s check out those options then.
Ok! Gimme a sec…
Blueberry Squid Tentacles, Natto Cake, or Okra Slushie.
Tough choice, right? Each one is painstakingly crafted by our chef and has a unique flavor.
Well?
You know what? Who says a cafe’s gotta update its menu?
Sorry, but none of them sound appetizing tbh…
Really? We’ll have to mull it over some more, I guess.
For that, I am grateful.
Not really my thing.
I see…
Yeah, they’re cool.
Really? I’m glad you like them.
I just snagged two new titles.
Wanna watch them with me?
Absolutely!
Yay! Let’s link up at the cafe in an hour?
Maybe next time.
No worries, next time it is then.
The Dream Garden Cafe does this annual getaway thing for the team. We were all talking about it today, and everyone’s keen to have you along.
Wow. Even though I’m not an employee?
Thanks! The ACD could learn a thing or two from the cafe.
So, I take that as a yes?
Of course, I’d be a fool to pass up such a sweet offer.
Great! I’ll tell everyone the good news.
By the way, any ideas on where to go and what to do?
Soak up the sun and vibes at the beach.
Explore some spooky caves up in the mountains.
Interesting choice.
Noted. I’ll ask the others and then we can brainstorm.
[Sticker]
Heard you swung by NCCA the other day.
Yes, ma’am! Nothing major, ma’am!
[Sticker]
So, you’re just gonna ‘ma’am’ me all day now?
[Sticker]
Just had some damage paperwork to sort out.
The last mission was pretty rough…but I’ll be more careful next time, ma’am!
Relax, will you? I’m not gonna bite your head off for a few broken windows.
…You know, I envy you sometimes.
Young, carefree, only your own battles to fight…
You could use a break yourself, ma’am.
Vacations are a luxury I can’t afford…
Not when the whole city’s counting on me.
You know what they say, heavy is the head that wears the crown and all that.
But it sounds a bit braggy when I put it that way.
…Too heavy for BBchat, huh? Didn’t mean to unload on you.
How about we go for a drive sometime, ma’am?
How about we catch a movie sometime, ma’am?
Trying to lift my spirits, huh?
You’re totally on my priority list~
Sup?
At your command, ma’am.
[Sticker]
[Sticker]
Saw an interesting psychology quiz this morning. Up for a little mind game?
Yes, ma’am!
Alright, let’s dive in… After a long journey, you finally reach the new world you’ve been dreaming about.
You see water up ahead.
What do you see? A small pond, a tranquil lake, or an ocean that stretches beyond the horizon?
A small pond.
You’re content with where you are in life and don’t feel the need to change things.
Looks like we’ll be working together for a while yet.
A tranquil lake.
You’re craving peace and quiet in your life. Maybe it’s time to slow down.
…Yeah, I feel that. Sometimes, I’d love a whole day to myself, too.
An ocean that stretches beyond the horizon.
You’re at a crossroads. Do you keep pushing forward, or do you turn back to safer shores?
Wouldn’t it be something to sail out into the unknown…with a good friend by your side?
What’s your pick, ma’am?
Now wouldn’t you like to know…
Let’s just say…the water’s a lot deeper than it seems.
Need some insight from our Chaos expert.
Spotted any humanoid Chaos with a massive appetite lately?
Not that I’m aware of. Something up, ma’am?
It’s not a big deal, but…the staff pantry at NCCA got wiped out this morning.
I mean, entirely cleared out. Even the canned mayo, ketchup sachets, and that half box of cupcake mix I had hidden are gone…
A bunch of handprints at the scene, so I’m thinking it was definitely a humanoid culprit.
Wait…you bake cupcakes?
Is that so hard to believe?
Tell you what, I’ll bake a dozen just for you—right after we crack this pantry caper.
Sounds like classic Chaos to me.
Oh really? But didn’t you just say you never heard of such a Chaos?
So, what’s your expert deduction, agent?
I know a certain resident glutton…
[Sticker]
[Sticker]
It’s a Pinchbot with hands! That’s the only possible answer!
I’m starting to think you’re covering up for a certain resident glutton.
We might need to have a little chat in my office later…
Guess I’d better start tracking down our culprit. She’s probably still on duty.
And no texting her a heads-up that I’m onto her, got it?
<player>.
I am simply inquiring if you often find yourself working late into the night.
Yeah, I guess so.
As expected. The late-night duties of agents are well-documented.
Well, you know, when duty calls, right? But it’s not that bad.
I frequently see reports of agents engaged in late-night duties.
Thanks to you and your companions, the nights are undoubtedly safer from Chaos.
I have recently obtained some tea that is beneficial for the eyes and liver. It appears to be more suitable for your requirements.
Additionally, I have procured coffee beans and a coffee machine. Should rest evade you, a robust brew may prove sufficient.
I’ll have them sent to you.
For that, I am grateful.
You’re most welcome.
It’s too much, really. I can’t accept them…
It is, I believe, what friends do for each other.
May we all continue to be safe and in good health.
Good day. The Aerie Bank is organizing a safety drill.
<player>. Would you be willing to play a part?
A part… like as one of the robbers?
Yes, we require someone with your specific skill set.
So, I get to legally rob a bank?
To a certain extent, yes.
The safety department has proposed a drill involving Chaos entities such as the Masked Malice as simulated perpetrators.
Naturally, you were the primary choice.
So, my skills are only Masked Malice level?
Ah, I see the misunderstanding. My apologies.
What I intended to convey is that, being far stronger than the Masked Malice, you would naturally excel in that role.
What about my compensation?
Be assured, we will ensure you are duly compensated.
If necessary, I can advocate for additional remuneration.
So, what is your decision?
Of course I’m in.
Splendid.
I will promptly inform you once the particulars are confirmed.
Let me think about it.
Not a problem.
The timing remains to be determined, so you may decide later.
Maybe now’s not the best time…
I understand. You must be preoccupied with official responsibilities.
I will instruct them to continue searching for suitable candidates.
Something rather awkward transpired.
There was a misunderstanding at the Fluffington Cafe.
What happened?
It took place this morning when I stopped by for coffee.

records.OptionText: Did they think you were there to talk business?
records.Message: Let me guess, they mistook you for a sales rep.
Something to that effect.

records.OptionText: Did they think you were there to pet cats?
records.Message: They thought you were there for the cats?
If only… They believed I was there to advocate a business loan.
Instead of being asked to leave, I found myself engaged in an amicable conversation with the proprietor.
Consequently, I shared some financial insights, drawing from my prior professional experience.
It evolved into a pleasant interaction overall.
Regrettably, I had to seek my coffee elsewhere.

records.OptionText: It’ll turn out better next time, I’m sure.
records.Message: What a morning, huh?
Still, you can hit them up for coffee later.
I suppose.

records.OptionText: Maybe a new outfit will help?
records.Message: Maybe you’re dressed too formally?
Try a more casual look next time, perhaps?
A reasonable suggestion. Thank you.
Then, raise your arms until they’re, like, totally parallel to the ground.
With palms facing down, breathe in and out twice.
Wait, there’s, like, a tail involved in this? What the heck?
Mistext?
Yeah, just, like, wrap your tail around your body three times. NBD.
<player>? Why are you in my notepad?
[Sticker]
OMG!! I accidentally sent you my yoga notes! Embarrassing!
Trying to shed some pounds?
Looking to get more toned?

records.Message: Where is everyone at?
Shouldn’t it be time already?
Anyone down for hitting the beach? If not, I’ll ask again later.
Hang on, I’m here.
So, where were we?
We were diggin’ into the subway mess.
Oh, right.
Straight up: best steer clear of the subway right now.
Why’s that?
Thought the subway was back to normal?
It just looks like it.
Hey <player>, remember that “A Certain Scientific Chaos Study”?
I just checked the log. Can’t believe he was a fraud.
I exposed him, and he bounced.
Sharp catch! I had no idea!
Clout chasing, I guess.
Ugh, like, how did I miss that? I totally thought he was some major player.
BTW, after school started, I handed in all my homework.
You got praised?
Well, not really.
But, some students tried to pull a ‘Chaos ate my homework’ and got totally roasted.
Thanks to you, I dodged the heat!
Anytime. Glad I could help.
Alright, I’ll hit you up first if there’s a mission.
Scratch that,
I’ll inform you immediately if there’s a mission notification!
Feel free to contact me for non-mission matters as well.
Sure, only if it ain’t a bother.
We’ve got each other’s back!
[Sticker]
I’ve been watching the subway data and spotted some Chaos risks.
If it escalates, it might be even worse than the previous incident.
What? I ride the subway every day…
For real?
Think of it like a weather forecast; just putting it out there.
Normally, they give updates and warnings about Chaos in advance,
but lately, nothing about the subway.
Announcing too early could spark panic, so it’s under wraps for now.
Ain’t it a bit much to claim the metro’s at risk of Chaos for no legit reason?
If I ran the metro, I’d consider that straight-up slander.
Yeah. That’s why we haven’t shared it publicly yet.
Makes sense.
Got it, skipping the subway for now.
Anyone down for hitting the beach? If not, I’ll ask again later.

records.ShareMsgIntro:
随着新启进入夏季
新启的海滩及水上游乐设施日益人气火爆。
但近日，一群网传名为“沙滩裤假面”的群体开始在新启各处频繁活动，引起了不小的社会问题。
据目击市民描述，该群体统一由健壮男性组成，他们穿着各色沙滩裤，头戴海滩题材的面具出没于新启街头，并对过路的市民做出各种怪异的姿势和出位的动作，更有甚者会躲藏在各式障碍物后，待市民路过时突然现身惊吓市民。
根据受害者纳威尔先生的描述，昨日，纳威尔像往常一样开车前往岸泊工业上班，却因为突然从路边灌木丛窜出的沙滩裤假面而受到惊吓，车辆失控装上路灯而受伤。
纳威尔先生表示自己将会起诉沙滩裤假面群体，并社会寻找目击证人。
新启市巡卫总署提醒各位新启市民，警惕并远离所有身着沙滩裤，赤裸上身，并且头戴面具的男子，也不要点赞和转发任何与沙滩裤假面相关的短视频内容。如遇到该团体成员骚扰，请立刻上报巡卫署，巡卫总署将随时待命，守护您的安全！

records.Message: You There? It’s Urgent!
Who are you?
Come on, who else would it be? You’re my go-to in Nova. I need your help, like, now.
I think you got the wrong number.
No way. You don’t recognize me? I’m in some serious trouble, and you’re the only one I can count on in Nova. You gotta help me out.
Taffy? You got a new number?
Taffy? Did you change your number?
Yep, it’s me. I’m borrowing a phone right now. Just got into a car accident, and my phone’s totally busted.
Are you okay?
I’m fine, but I smashed into someone’s car, and now I gotta cover the damage.
You didn’t hit someone, did you?
Nah, just their car. But I have to cover the repair costs.
But I gotta sort this under the table otherwise my license will get revoked, and the repair bill’s insane. I ain’t got that cash…
I told you, no phones while driving the taxi.
I know, I know. My bad. Please, I need you to front me some cash, or I’m losing my license and my gig.
I told you, ditch the headphones while delivering…
Ugh, yeah, I know. Too late for regrets. Need cash, or they’re booting me from deliveries.
Fine, but when will you pay me back?
Thanks! I’ll pay you back next month with interest, for real!
Alright, I got you.
Thanks, knew I could count on you.
We’re at a repair joint on Paradox Street, but I ain’t done for the day. Just pass the cash to the car owner, cool?
She’s in a black knit sweater and blue jeans. I gotta finish up, or they’re docking my pay.
You There? It’s Urgent!
Seriously? Again?
You want a beating or something?
Wait, what? Whoa, what’s up? Why so heated?
Wait, are you… Taffy for real?
Is it really you this time?
Who else, Cap? You don’t even recognize my digits? That stings!
My bad, sent it to the wrong person…
Nah, just dealing with some stuff…
Alright, for the sake of our partnership, I’ll let it slide.
Almost forgot, got something urgent!
You didn’t crash into a car, did you?
Did you get into an accident?
What? Are you cursing me or something?
Okay, no more jokes. Ringo just told me someone’s faking my identity to scam folks. Be careful.
I know you ain’t gonna fall for it, but just a heads-up. Gotta bounce, catch you later!
If you snap any pics of evidence, send ’em over.
Send the evidence photos.
Got the records, victim list, and all their gear right here.
Sweet. With this, those scammers are toast. Leave the rest to us at NCCA!
So, I can leave now?
No sweat, we’ll handle the takedown. Our squad needs the practice. Just wait for my update.
Hello, this is the NCCA Reporting Center. How can I assist you today?
Send the evidence photos
I found a scammer hideout
Got the files and victim list
I have all the evidence
Thank you for your report. We will dispatch officers immediately. Thank you for your contribution to the safety of Nova.
There’s someone named Elivia…
She’s trapped in the there and has been helping me gather evidence…
Understood. Rest assured, the NCCA will ensure her safe rescue.
Sent the address to your phone. Delete it immediately after reading. If they catch this, I’m toast.
Hideout address
Hey hey, you there? McHarris?
Here, Agent Taffy!
Meet my partner, <player>, our Ace Agent.
Hey there! So glad you guys are helping out.
You at the open-air stage yet?
//塔菲发出拍摄的照片
records.__RAW__Message: //塔菲发出拍摄的照片

records.Message: Cool, snap a pic from this angle.
Got it, hang on a sec.
//麦哈里斯发来了一张地点角度相同的自拍
records.__RAW__Message: //麦哈里斯发来了一张地点角度相同的自拍

records.Message: Did you get it?
Yeah… It’s really at the open-air stage, and the angle is exactly the same. Did you just take this?
Of course, I matched your photo exactly. No way I could fake it. I’m literally standing here right now.
Hmm… but I don’t see you. Looks like “No Man’s Nova” is legit.
Yeah, I’ve been stuck here for over a month. Please, you’ve gotta get me out of here.
Something feels off about this pic.
Off? I don’t see anything weird.
Wait a sec, why is your photo mirrored?
Mirrored? What do you mean?
Yeah, seriously, the letters in the pic are backward.
Backward letters? No way, it looks normal to me.
Wait, hold up! The pic you sent me is flipped on my end.
A reversed world… Could this No Man’s Nova be like a mirror universe? How did you even get there?
Honestly, I have no idea. I was just doing my usual thing.
Biking down the streets, and then bam, no one around, and I ended up here.
This place is just like Nova, except totally empty. I’ve been looking for an exit for a month now, but no luck.
Luckily, I found out the internet here connects to the real world.
I see… Don’t worry, we’ll find a way to get you out.
Thanks, I’m counting on you. I’ll keep searching for an exit. Let me know If you find anything.
Will do, stay in touch.
Taffy, <player>, I’ve stashed the item.
//麦哈里斯发来一张照片
records.__RAW__Message: //麦哈里斯发来一张照片

records.Message: Left it on the rooftop of 1UP.
Barely anyone goes up there, so if the two worlds are actually connected, the box should still be there.
On it.
You guys found the box, right? I looked away for like a sec and it was gone.
Yeah, we found it, but the card was totally flipped.
What the? Is this place like a mirror world or something?
Let’s do another experiment.
I’m listening.
Maybe we should try flipping something back.
Flipping? How’s that gonna work?
Alright, here’s the plan…
We’ll put a new item somewhere and drop you the location. See if you can find it.
We’ll set up a camera and see what we find.
Sounds good, let’s go for it.
Cool, any supplies you need?
Hmm… I’ve been stuck here for ages, but I’ve got plenty of stuff.
Although manga here doesn’t update. Missed a bunch of Shonen Fly.
Can you guys bring me the latest issue? Pls?
No problem, we got you.
I got the stuff. How’s it looking on your end? Is the box still there?
//发来照片
records.__RAW__Message: //发来照片

records.Message: Vanished. Looks like it’s the same on both sides.
Hold up, this manga…
Wait. Don’t tell me the manga’s reversed too?
Yep… Manga’s all types of wrong. The whole thing’s backward. Reading this is gonna a trip.
Hmm… maybe you could try reading it through a mirror? That should do the trick, right?

For more information, please contact our customer service hotline. Thank you for your support!

Smoking and barbecuing are strictly prohibited in forested areas. Additionally, please conserve water and cherish every drop. We must work together to build a better home. Thank you for your cooperation!

Maintaining a beautiful environment requires everyone’s effort. Details can be obtained at the community center.
[YooToo] Dear user, the “Handy Annie” you subscribed to has just uploaded a new video: “How to Make a Jet Chair at Home”. We hope you enjoy this video! — Best regards, YoWo Team.

[Indigo] Dear member, our Sales Carnival will be here soon! PS: All product are now on SALE, with amazing 50% off coupons waiting for you to grab! Only once a year! Don’t miss out!! Reply “N” to unsubscribe.

For any issues or concerns, please contact NCCA available 24/7 at 505. Let’s join hands in making this a safer city! — The NCCA

[Chaos PSA] Greetings, citizen. Recently, new Chaos entities have been sighted near the Pop Cool Buildsite. For your safety, please do not travel alone and avoid traveling at night. Should you encounter a Chaos, keep calm and quietly back away. Do NOT feed or provoke it. In case of emergency, please contact NCCA available 24/7 at 505.
I really don’t get it. Haven’t I given you my heart this whole time?
It’s been this long — I’m sure you know what I mean
You keep dragging things out with me and never explain clearly
Just spit it out already. Don’t hold back
I don’t have feelings for you
Liar
I need the report from last week finished today.
But I’m not in the office today.
Is there a problem?
No. No problem.
Then it’s settled. Next Saturday at 18:00, private room at Kara-OK!
Say “No” and I’ll break you in half!
Yeah, yeah, how could I miss your birthday?
Hmph. Are my gifts ready?
Ages ago! Get ready to be amazed.
If Nova gets hit with another massive Chaos Disaster tomorrow, like a meteor strike, what do you think people of the city should do?
Huh? What kinda question is that?
I’m serious. Can never be too careful.
Otherwise, you’ll have nowhere to go when the time comes.
What are you getting at?

Here’s the thing, miss. We’ve got a property near the coast, and even if the whole city gets wiped out, you’ll be fine! The average price is only 150,000 Golvent, and we’ve even built a specialized underground bunker for ANY potential disasters. How does that sound?
I need to vent about today’s interview with you
Didn’t you have a good impression of this company before the interview?
It was insane
You know what that last question they asked me was?
He asked me if I liked Masked Malice or Televised Collective.
Huh? What’d you say?
Televised Collective — duh!
But then he said I wasn’t cut out for their company.
I’m playing gacha now. That one looks cool!
Oh! I wanna play, too!
Is my idol in it?
Bring me some fan merch
I’ll send you some pics after I open the rest of these gacha cards.
Dratz! No luck… 10 more, let’s go!
Sob…
I’ll never get what I want…
When are you headed home, Mom?
What’s wrong?
Didn’t I tell you I’d be home a little late today?
But, Mom…
Our dog’s talking to me…
And I’m a bit freaked out…
Huh? Are you serious? You’re not just hearing things?
I’m serious! I tried talking to it multiple times
Hurry home, Mom!
Hello, I spoke with you online about buying your phone
Hello
Mind if I come by and take a look?
I’ll take it if it’s in good condition
How’s this afternoon? We can meet at Brock Plaza on Glimmergold Lane.
By the cat statue.
Sure, but… Can you send me 240 Golvent for the cab? I’ll pay you for everything all at once.
Fine.
[240 Golvent transferred]
[Transfer received]
See you then!

records.Message: How have things been recently?
Not so good. My anxiety’s been keeping me up all night
96% of your worries will not transpire. You can relax
But it’s that 4% I’m worried about
Headed back to 1UP for another round today?
Didn’t you just win? And you’re headed back?
Didn’t you hear about level 8? It’s a hidden underwater level.
Are the legends true?
Indeed. You gotta go play that old arcade.
It’ll trigger once you kill the “Alien Heart”.
Can you tell a crocodile from an alligator?
Nope. Can you?
A crocodile has a long, pointy snout.
And an alligator?
Want to go swimming with them and find out? Report back to me.
Did you see the new pants Surge just released?
The colors are to die for. I love it!
Wanna go check them out tomorrow?
Sure! And we can stop by that vintage store we went to last time.
Oh, right! It’s been a while.
Alright, see you tomorrow!
Ok.
I heard you lost another match?
I have nothing to say. Block me, and move on. Thanks.
Well, that’s cold.
I went out of my way to book a booth at Bassline 808…
But if you don’t wanna come, suit yourself.
Whoa! Well, if it isn’t my good ol’ buddy pal, Jack?
Hey! How’s it going, bro!?
Dancing, huh? Looks like my schedule’s cleared for today.
Hello, Ms. Rose, this is Jeffrey who visited yesterday. How are you considering my proposal?
Oh! Hello, Jeffrey.
I’ll cut to the chase. We really like your company’s products.
But we also need to follow our own procedures. I need to report to the upper management and wait for their approval. Is that okay?
Of course! That’s to be expected!
Here’s the situation… After speaking with my boss, we are quite interested in this opportunity.
If we can sign the contract by next week.
We’d be willing to offer an additional 3%
You missed it! That benchwarmer from the Explorers went on a rampage in Paradox Plaza yesterday!
I mean, he *is* a professional athlete. No way you guys are on the same level.
Totally blew my mind. He seemed really clumsy during the previous match, though. Right?
Yeah, he dropped the ball 3 times right at the end against the Fire Lizards. I was so mad.
Everyone thinks he’s useless. Even I could do better!
You know what happened? Yesterday, he crossed up everyone on the court and then threw down a windmill dunk!
I finally get why you should never put your hobby against someone’s profession!
Watching TV yesterday, I realized that many dramas don’t make much sense logically.
You know when someone’s hiding, then they accidentally make a noise and alert the patrol, right?
Then the person hiding meows like a cat, and the patrol just goes away.
Yeah, it’s pretty common. What’s wrong?
Isn’t that weird, though?
Because if you hear a cat, aren’t you going to go pet it? ​​
Well, if you put it that way…
You know the bald guy in our department? He wore makeup to our company outing yesterday.
Whoa!
After staring at his red cheeks all night, which got even worse after a few drinks, I just had to ask him…
You’re crazy…
He said: “My wife likes it when I look nice~”
Aw, that’s cute
1:00 am, day after tomorrow: graffiti at Pop Cool Ruins
BYOP
Reminder: Bring a portable camera if you wanna take pics. There will be climbing
Hmm…
Alright, you’re out
Huh? Why?
You hesitated
I’m really sorry for wrecking your car yesterday. I’ll pay you today. I promise.
No worries. Good thing I don’t need to use my car today.
But, I do need to remind you…
What’s that?
Turn signals mean “I’m about to turn.”
Not…
“Look! LOOK! I’m turning now! Now! I’m turning NOW!”
S-sorry…
My butt hurts…
Went skateboarding again? You can quit, ya know? There’re tons of other hobbies to choose from.
Skateboarding’s dangerous. What happens if you fall and break your face?
You don’t understand! Skateboarding is fun. It’s cool. It’s exciting. And you can do it anywhere.
I just need some more practice, and I’ll get better in no time. Learning each trick has been a blast, and it’s even better with a friend.
Ugh, why do skateboarders have to be so dense? You do you, I guess.
You just don’t get it. There’s only one rule to skating: have fun!
I wanna buy a tank.
Go for it!
But I’m broke.
Take out a loan!
But then I can’t pay it back.
What are you afraid of? You got a tank!
Eh, forget it. Just taking it for a spin is at least 4 stars.
I need some cash, bro.
Again? Sure you got what it takes to be an influencer?

When I see a Chaos, it brings me cheer,

records.Message: I heard Investigation Section 9 is getting shut down?
What?
No way!
I submitted my report on time, I swear!
Relax, nothing’s wrong with your report.
The department is reviewing how many cases each officers closes, and those at the bottom might get reassigned.
Nothing but hearsay. Ignore it.
As long as I’m around, Section 9 isn’t going anywhere.
Plus, we just got a super rookie!
The whole department’s talkin’ about that huge case she just cracked.
The Director agreed to transfer Richie to our team because she’s got high hopes for us!
Oh, and Richie, I’ve got some good news for you.
Is it a bonus?
Is it snacks?
No.
Stop by the station when you get a chance; I have some things to teach you.
(Location)
If Section 9 gets shut down…
All those pie-in-the-sky promises he made to his ex-wife would…
I’m right here.
Sorry!
Section 9 won’t be dissolved for now.
But don’t get too comfortable! The department is keeping a close eye on us.
Take on as many assignments and solve as many cases as possible. Show us what you’re made of.
Especially you, Richie. The more you do, the more experience you’ll gain, which will improve your skills.
Keep it up, you young guns. I’ve got to get back to work.
So, what exactly are those promises?
I’ll DM you later!
I’ll do my best.
You’re pretty quick!
As fast as I can send you flying.
You better thank your lucky stars I’m busy typing,
or I’d come over and teach you guys a lesson!
Hey, the new girl is watching us.
Oh.
@Richie Welcome to Section 9! We’re one big happy family here!
May we work together and achieve great things!
Welcome aboard!
Welcome.
I have a template for that report.
Be sure to submit it within a week; late submissions will affect our performance rating.
Though Harry’ll take the brunt of it.
If my pay goes down, I’m taking you all down with me!
Where are we going?
At this rate? To the unemployment office.
We haven’t cleared too many cases…
How long has it been?
I barely remember what it feels like to write a closure report.
It’s been almost seven months.
Why’re you so antsy? it hasn’t even been a year!
I’m trying my best to inject some new talent into our team!
We’ll aim to crack big cases every day and make headlines every week!
Citizens would get anxious hearing about all that crime.
Can’t you think of something more positive?
Are you feeling this way because of the divorce?
Probably.

其次，"书海骨骸头颅下"——书海就是飞骨图书馆，骨骸头颅自然是那里悬挂的巨型鲸鱼骨架。
最后，"熙熙花正开"——熙熙指的是跟鲸鱼匹配的装束，那自然就是泳装了！
都穿着泳衣站在骨架上面了，自然要往下跳了！
所以答案就是：午夜12点，身着泳装前往飞骨图书馆的鲸鱼骨架陈列区，从鲸鱼头骨正上方纵身跃下！

Maybe just go out. I’m sure you’ll find something after a stroll outside.
NO WAY! Nuh uh!
I’ve used up my “go-out” energy for the month. I’m staying put.
I need to let it recharge.
Are you sure you’re not a cyborg?
[Night night]
I know! I’m thinking a triple-flavor deluxe ice cream sandwich!
Pretty sure that’s not a proper meal…
Isn’t that just pure sugar… but frozen?
So what? I don’t see the problem.
Oh, hold up, there’s this other spot.
The new cheese fondue joint on Glimmergold Lane’s been getting raves.
I actually also want to try that.
But it’ll have to wait till I’m fully charged.
Hey hey hey!
Guess where I’m at?
Paradox Plaza?
Holy chips! Now I see why they call you the ace!
Actually, you tagged your location on Scope…
Oh right…
Anyway! There’s this train here that nobody knows where it’s from or where it’s going.
I’ve been scoping it out for a bit now, and it seems legit!
Let me guess, you’re flying solo, again?
Yup. Finished the new batch of games. Got all the achievements. Bored.
No better time for a quest for the paranormal!
Hmm, sounds like there may be Chaos involved.
Sounds interesting, I’m in.
Wait, what?
You’re NOT thinking of coming here, right!?
Sorry…
Guess I freaked out at the thought of meeting someone irl.
It’ll turn out better next time, I’m sure.
I understand.
But if it’s meeting up to play games together…
I think I can give it a shot!
How late does 1UP close anyways…
Good morning! Here’s your milk. Did you notice the sticker on top?
The little blue cow?
That’s the one! Shannon Dairy is having an anniversary celebration.
Some of the milk bottles have random stickers attached, and if you collect three, you can exchange them for a mystery gift!
What’s the gift?
[Sticker]
A ticket for a tour of the Shannon factory and ranch! You can experience the fun of milking a cow firsthand!
What do you think? Interested?
That’s it?
Of course not! We’ll also be giving out all sorts of rich and creamy dairy products guaranteed to be positively moolicious!
Sounds fun.
Not only that, but if you collect enough stickers, I’ll teach you how to communicate with cows. I’m really good at it.
Come find me when you collect enough!
<player>, I just encountered the Milk Bandit!
What happened?
I’d just gotten out of the truck to grab two boxes of milk, when suddenly I heard some noise coming from the truck.
I quietly crept over to take a look, and lo and behold, I saw a bandit dressed in black with white spots, wearing white gloves.
When it saw me, it let out a “meow” and pounced over. Now I’ve caught it red-handed!
What do you intend to do with this bandit?
Well, since it was only trying to steal out of hunger, I decided to feed it some treats along with some milk, then take it to the vet.
I suggest handing the bandit over to the Fluffington Cafe.
That’s exactly the plan! I’m going to send this felonious feline there so it can reform and earn its own food.
Talk later, <player>. I need to put this bandit in the cat cage.
[Sticker]
Hey, <player>. The weather is really nice this morning.
Did you wake up early again?
Yep, ever since I started delivering milk, I haven’t slept in once.
Anyway, guess what my favorite thing about mornings is.
The fresh morning air?
Exactly! Nothing’s more comfortable than that slightly dewy, cool morning air. Sometimes you can even see the sun peeking its head over the horizon.
The roads being less crowded?
You bet! Driving early in the morning is a rare treat. You can amble all over the road just like a cow… just kidding! But it really is fun.
Actually, what I love the most is downing a delicious breakfast after a busy morning when my stomach is growling.
When you’ve got warm waffles paired with Shannon milk, you know it’s gonna be another great day!
[Sticker]
Finding a library book a whole year past due while cleaning up…
I guess even the ever-composed Dila can forget things sometimes.

records.OptionText: Hope the overdue fee isn’t too much.
records.Message: Which library? Hope the overdue fee isn’t too much.
Wondering if the door’s really locked after hopping on the subway…
…Unsettling.
Yeah, thoughts be like that sometimes.
Feeling like something important still needs to be done right before bed…
But can’t figure out what it is.
Have you had a particularly stressful day?
[Sticker]
My day’s been fine. Just brainstorming some anxiety-inducing moments for my new story.
Getting the heebie-jeebies yet?
Yeah, sounds like stuff straight out of my life.
Exactly! That’s what makes it extra scary.
…I just double-checked if my door’s locked.
Seems like it’s working, then.
[Sticker]
Oh, I just thought of something even scarier.
I messed up and posted my alt’s stuff on main!
Enough!
[Sticker]
<player>. Got this weird letter this morning. I think it’s from one of my readers…
It was just lying in the doorway. They probably slid it in through the door gap.
Having a fan base is a good thing, right?
Congrats! Must be a proud moment for a writer.
Yeah, but… I never gave my address to anyone.
Did you get doxxed? Get any sketchy DMs lately?
I don’t know… The letter even uses my real name, not my pen name.

records.OptionText: Might be some kind of prank?
records.Message: Might be some kind of prank by a friend?
Could be… the letter used my real name instead of my pen name.
This is what it says…
I reveal myself to you, a creature of Chaos in the form of a letter most ordinary.
Look behind you if you wish to seek solace within darkness.
Omw. Don’t turn around, Dila.
[Sticker]
I’m really sorry, <player>. You don’t have to come over… It’s just a new idea I’m trying out for my story.
I was struggling with some of the dialogue and reactions, so…
Still there? I’m so sorry! Can I make it up to you somehow? Wanna grab dinner? My treat!
[Sticker]
I’d need to hit up a movie in those plush, premium theater seats to calm down…
I heard they released new seasonal dishes at the Dream Garden Cafe…
[Yummy]
Say no more. Meet me there.
[’Sup]
Know anywhere fun and exciting, <player>? Need some inspo for my latest piece.
I hear there’s a heavy metal gig in Paradox Plaza tonight.
Chaos breaking loose in the middle of a killer guitar solo… Could work!
Gotta look the part too. Where can I snag some studded belts and boots right now?
Observe, Dila, don’t disturb.
[Sticker]
The Televised Collective have an event in the Azure Sector tonight.
Looked it up, seems like a drive-in movie thing. Hold up…
Three mob gore flicks in one night? That’s a whole lot of action and blood.
Well, you know how they do. Just watch your back.
Yeah, all those young gang members, riled up and ready to throw down… This will be good.
Rixxy Wonderland is throwing its annual Splash Bash event.
I looked it up. Seems like the Jello Chaos are extra active this time of year.
You buy a water gun at the entrance and…repel the rampaging Rixxies into the sea?
Isn’t that the staff’s job? Whoever runs that place sure knows how to do business.
[Dizzy]
Alrighty. Thanks for the tip.
Can’t wait to check it out.
And I can’t wait for your new story.
[Ayy]
<player>, are you free later?
That depends on what you need.
I found a cat cafe of note, and was hoping you could accompany me.

records.OptionText: I’m sure I can pencil that in.
records.Message: I’m sure I can pencil that in.
Excellent. I’ve added “Visit Cat Cafe” to your schedule, <player>.
Did you just hack into my phone again?
According to my program, there are over thirteen spam and scam messages on your phone.
These messages increase your risk of being scammed by 30%.
Especially this subway ticket refund message. The algorithm estimates your risk of being scammed at 18%.
While I was clearing these scam messages, I added this event to your schedule.
Wait, that message was a scam?
It appears I need to adjust your scam probability parameters.
Well, thanks for that…
<player>.
Please do not set your password to 123456 again.
But it’s so convenient…
Such a rudimentary password increases your risk of being hacked by 700%.
I strongly suggest you use a more secure password.
I don’t think it’s necessary. I trust you.
I don’t believe any hacker could bypass your defenses.
That is indeed true.
As your collaborator, I will ensure your information is secure.
Nevertheless, I still hope you can pay more attention to your own information security.
Understood.
I’ll change it to 1234567.
Forget it.
Are you planning to go to the movies?
How did you know?
Allow me to explicate.
When I accessed your phone, I only focused on information related to your safety, not to your privacy.
While hacking into the movie theater’s ticketing software, I happened to see your booking information.

records.OptionText: Would you like to join me?
records.Message: Would you like to join me?
I’ll treat you.
No need.
I’ve already hacked into the ticketing system and reserved the seat next to you.
I believe watching this movie will help me better understand humans.
But it’s an ecological documentary about Chaos.
I realize that, but observing your reactions and those of the other moviegoers will prove most interesting.
Alright, see you later.
Stand with your legs 140 cm apart and arms extended.
Palms facing down, breathe twice. Tail…?
Did you mean to send this someone else?
The tail wraps around the body three times.
Oh, sorry about that!
Are these notes for a workout?
Yeah, a yoga routine.
The doctors told me that excessive training can lead to muscle tension.
That’s not good for recovery and can make me feel hungrier.
That’s manageable enough. If you’re hungry, just eat more to replenish your energy.
You make a valid point.
Agent No.1, there’s a general knowledge competition this weekend at NCCA.
I’m a bit worried about flubbing my answers.
Don’t worry, I’ll practice with you.
Question: If a vampire claims to “only drink tomato juice,” do they need to apply for a “Provisional Chaos Night Travel Permit”?
No, they don’t.
They must, however, carry a blood type identification report issued by a hospital, and ensure all the information is filled in.
But Mr. Lord can’t even defeat that orange cat at Glimmergold.
Human blood is not something he can obtain.
Mr. Lord is an exception.
Yeah, he really gives vampires a bad name.
<player>. Has anyone from the NCCA hit you up lately?
Asking questions about missing food and the like?
Nope, why?
I was starving after my shift yesterday, so I wolfed down all the snacks in the rec room pantry.
Fortunately, I managed to skedaddle before everyone came back.
The NCCA is launching an investigation, so if they ask you…
I think they already know it was you. Pretty sure this “investigation” is just a cover story to help you save face.
How embarrassing.
I need to make this right before everyone notices.
I’ll pretend I don’t know anything. You have my word.
Thank you. This shouldn’t count as covering up.
Anyway, enough about that. I have a mission. I’ll treat you to a hamburger tonight.
<player>, have you gotten into any hot water lately?
You’re on the NCCA’s watchlist. I’ve seen colleagues in other departments digging into your case.
Don’t worry, I’ve got it under control.
If that were true, we wouldn’t be having this conversation.
Yeah, I guess I’ve been going a bit hard lately. My bad.
Small mistakes can snowball into big trouble. It’s a story I’ve heard at the NCCA a million times before.
You need to lay low.
Sorry, but I won’t be able to help you for a while.
<player>, good news!
I can come back into the fold.
You’re not coming back to arrest me, are you?
Of course not.
You’ve been minding your P’s and Q’s, so you’re officially off the NCCA watchlist.
Sorry for causing so much trouble before.
It was no skin off my back. The investigation was all handled by other departments.
They’ve moved on to other cases.
I’m sorry for doubting you earlier.
I should have trusted you. That’s on me.
Hey…the guys at DK9 are pretty upset with you.
[Sticker]
I know, I’ve been making a bit of scene lately.
You’re making things really difficult for me in the gang…
I can’t help you out anymore, at least not for now. We can talk again when things settle down.
Meanwhile, you take some time to think things over.
[Sticker]
I’m sorry! My fists… it’s like they’ve got a mind of their own…
Wait, are you serious?
[Sticker]
If you need help, I know a great doctor who can get you fitted with a mechanical arm.
No thanks. I’ll deal with it myself.
Alright then, take care of yourself. We’ll see each other again when the time’s right.
Hey, you there?
The guys have got nothing but praise for you lately. You really live up to the hype!
I’m back in the mix!
Sorry for causing all that trouble before.
Haha, water under the bridge, buddy. No need to apologize.
Looking forward to seeing you again!
[Sticker]
Things got pretty boring without you around.
Same here. Now that everything’s sorted, we can hang out again!
I’m stoked!
[Sticker]
You remember the gallery?
After I helped you escape, the place closed its doors.
Not to say that the exhibitions inside ever stopped.
It’s simply invite-only now.
Figures.
Should we commence with the plan?
Why don’t you swing by Tamayura? We can meet up there.
Sure. Be there shortly.
Hey, Garm. How’re things on your end?
Pops sent me to check on you.
Be sure to visit him when you’re free.
Did you see the display screen in the gallery?
If anything happens to it, it’s coming outta your paycheck!
Got it, Boss!
The display screen in the main hall’s acting up.
We can’t spare anyone from this area, so go find someone to fix it.
Hello?
Report in!
Hey, have you looked at Scope?
No, what is it?
Someone caught our basketball showdown on camera, and it’s getting tons of likes! Online traffic is pouring in!
I didn’t realize sports content was so popular…
The hashtag #YeetMasterVsAthlete# is already trending!
I told you, this stuff has serious potential! We gotta collab again sometime and get another viral hit! Just let me brainstorm a script first.
Hey, I’ve got a great video idea!
Let’s hear it.
The fans are clamoring to see us compete again. How about we play darts this time?
That’s right up my alley.
Let’s meet up at the entrance of 808.
(Location)
See you soon!

Let’s get along well from now on.
If there’s anywhere in Nova City you want to go together, just let me know anytime.

Next time, invite me along.
I need some inspiration.
